snippet.title: Echo Tower - Anouncement Trailer
snippet.description:
Now available on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4341660/Echo_Tower

Will you be brave enough to climb the tower using only your hearing?

Echo Tower is a game mixing action, puzzle and dungeon crawler where your ears replace your eyes!

AUDIO GAME FULLY ACCESSIBLE TO BLIND AND VISUALLY IMPAIRED PEOPLE

___________________________________________________________

Echo - Antonio Ortiz: https://www.antonioortizvoice.com/
BeepBop - Helen Tess: https://x.com/HelenTessVO
The Tower - Zach Zugheri: https://x.com/Zach_Zugheri
Grandpa & Trailer voice - Eric Crawford: https://linktr.ee/EricCrawford
